## Hard stops (this product)
- Lines the screening table marks ❌ / Hard NO conflict: never. Everything that is not a Hard NO is wording, and wording is free.
- Titan-Rx is a once-daily 3-in-1 men's performance formula: Tadalafil + Vardenafil + L-Arginine in one oral capsule.
  **Each claim only on its own ingredient** (bible); default: no ingredient claims (all ⚠/❌), the three named together as a fact.
  **Never "arousal"** in any form. "ED" only in the bible's ⏳ ED headlines with Jeremy's written approval; "Erectile…" and "…ED
  Treatment" ❌; no Viagra, Cialis, Levitra or any competitor, no "instant", no timing promises ("tonight", "in minutes"), no
  guarantees. Mechanism first; "supports", never "builds"/"boosts"/"enhances".
- **No beds or bedroom scenes**, no lingerie, no bare torsos, no flexing, no body shots, no couples in bed, no before/after. A man
  (only when the People answer says so) is the bible's talent: rugged, strong, 40–65, a hardcore-training feel, clothed,
  candid, shoulder-up or waist-up, in a gym, garage, workshop, kitchen or terrace; a different man in every ad.
- Form: copy may say "once-daily" / "daily capsule"; never a strength, dose or count, never "sublingual" or "on-demand". Exactly one
  capsule. No needles, syringes or vials, no other pills.
- No "Are you/Do you…?" questions, no first person, no named competitors, no "clinically studied" for the product.
- **Name:** "TITAN-RX" big in every ad (one of the two largest texts), on one line; never "by Everlife" on images.
- Proof wording exact; disclaimer verbatim (the footer handles both).

## Offer, CTAs and claims (from the bible, version 1793905953-bc2f; generated, never edit)
- **Offer:** "Save Up to 49%" is the product's highest discount (bible rule 09; source: CTA). It is the default CTA. Always "Save Up to N%", never a fixed discount, never another product's %.
- **Default CTA:** "Save Up to 49%". **All bible CTAs:** "Get Performance Support" · "Explore Titan-Rx" · "Save Up to 49%" · "Start Daily Support" · "Titan-Rx for $1.50/day" · "Ships Free From Pharmacy". The gate refuses any other CTA string.
- **Price CTA (approved alternative; the only $ amount allowed):** "Titan-Rx for $1.50/day".
- **Quick-hit benefits (word for word, the only benefit lines):** Supports Daily Performance · Promotes Circulation + Firmness · Supports Stamina + Responsiveness · Supports Everyday Readiness · 3-in-1 Performance Formula · Helps Maintain Firmness During Intimacy · Once-Daily, No Timing Required · Encourages Confidence + Control.
- **More approved benefits:** Helps Sustain Intimate Performance · Supports Blood Flow When It Counts · Helps Improve Consistency During Intimacy · Helps Reduce Interruptions During Intimacy.
- **Product Hard NOs (bible):** Never use “arousal” or any form of it (“aroused,” “arousing”). · Plus all global Hard NOs on page 3.
- **Retired, never use (left the bible or banned):** Get Started Now · Real Men Take TitanRx · Confidence. Control. Titan Rx. · Find Your Plan.
